name: Token Insights
description: A private, local JSONL scanner that turns recorded PI-Desktop token usage into trends, model and provider rankings, rhythm, and encouraging streaks.
author: PI-Desktop
changelog: Native local scanning: parses session JSONL files in the plugin process, stores a de-identified dashboard snapshot, adds provider categories, and removes the unavailable host usage API dependency.
safetyNotes: Scans local session JSONL metadata only. It aggregates usage, time, model, provider, and short session IDs; it does not retain or expose message content, tool arguments, project paths, or session titles, and it makes no network requests.

agentTools.name: token_usage_summary
agentTools.description: Scan local PI-Desktop session JSONL metadata and summarize token usage by model, provider, day, or short session ID without returning message text.

since.description: Start of the window, inclusive. ISO date or date-time (2026-07-01), or a relative shorthand such as 7d, 30d, 12w, 1y.

until.description: End of the window, exclusive. ISO date or date-time. Defaults to now.

groupBy.description: Which ranking to expand in the reply. Defaults to model.

limit.description: Max rows in the expanded ranking (default 10, max 25).
